summary: Unanchored weekly scan (no triggering issue). Read 4 shown reports; none were omitted or suppressed and no source was degraded. Proposes one draft clustering two reports of the CSV export failing silently, flags one request for a hosted offering as drift against non-goal N2, and leaves one usage question undrafted.

rubric_citations.note: Both reports describe a correctness failure in a shipped feature.

proposed_issue.title: CSV export completes without writing any rows
proposed_issue.body: Two users (UR-issue-12, UR-issue-40) report that exporting a run list to CSV reports success but produces an empty file. UR-issue-40 adds that the export works for lists under one page. Expected: the file contains every listed run, or the export fails with a named error.

n_drift.note: Requests a hosted multi-tenant offering, which non-goal N2 excludes.

not_drafted.note: Asks how to change the export delimiter; answerable from the docs.
